# S-matrix -> QuantEM hand-over (stand-in, generated by make_standin.py)

Two 3-atom clusters at 30 and 70 A in a 100 A slab, 300 kV, 20 mrad, 3 defoci. True probes differ from the metadata:
dataset 1 (the one QuantEM uses) has C10 -44 A (metadata -50) and C12a/b = 8/-5 A (metadata 0). One seed, CPU,
40 S-matrix epochs, 60 QuantEM iterations (object only for the first 12, then object + probe). REPORT.md is the
default configuration (pixelated probe, lr 1e-4).

S-matrix fit for dataset 1: C10 -44.2 A, C12a/b 6.8/-4.1 A, probe vs truth 0.040 rad RMS phase.
Hand-over check: QuantEM's initial probe equals the S-matrix probe in phase (0.000 rad RMS); overlap 0.993 only because
QuantEM uses a soft aperture edge.

Probe vs truth (RMS phase error inside the aperture, rad), start -> end of QuantEM, and the per-slab object correlation:

| QuantEM probe update | baseline (nominal probe, uniform, flat) | sprobe (S probe, uniform, flat) | sinit (all from S-matrix) | per-slab corr. baseline / sinit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pixelated, lr 1e-3 | 0.276 -> 0.222 | 0.040 -> 0.251 | 0.040 -> 0.206 | 0.863 / 0.900 |
| pixelated, lr 1e-4 (default) | 0.276 -> 0.207 | 0.040 -> 0.076 | 0.040 -> 0.073 | 0.853 / 0.902 |
| parametric (QuantEM refines C10, C12, phi12), lr 0.2 A | 0.276 -> 0.083 | 0.040 -> 0.137 | 0.040 -> 0.051 | 0.798 / 0.867 |

Initial object from the refocused S-matrix volume (--init-object volume, pixelated lr 1e-4): loss 0.476 (candidates
0.498), projected-phase correlation 0.972 (0.950), per-slab 0.911 (0.902), but the 70 A cluster splits into peaks at
64 and 78 A.

Reading: the S-matrix probe is the best probe in every row; a pixelated probe update at lr 1e-3 throws most of that
away, 1e-4 keeps most of it.  The parametric model lets QuantEM fix a wrong nominal probe by itself (baseline 0.083) and
keeps the S-matrix probe best (0.051), at some cost in the object here.  Single seed: M6 showed +-0.07 loss and +-4 A
depth run-to-run noise, so differences of that size are not significant.
